===Siding with Hazeel=== [[File:Hazeel Cult - Quest map.png|thumb|409px|Map Showing the Hazeel Cult Quest Legend:
1: Start quest, [[Ceril Carnillean]], 2: [[Clivet]], 3: [[Alomone]] (level 13), A: Quest Area (Area to travel, from begin to end). Green Numbers are marking valves.]] [[File:Hazeel chathead.png|left|frameless]] If you've chosen to side with [[Hazeel]], make sure you have a free inventory slot and then talk to [[Clivet]] to learn about [[Hazeel]]. He will explain that Hazeel is an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. '''Accept.''' He wants you to prove your loyalty by killing Ceril. Ask him how, and he will give you some poison and instruct you to pour it in Ceril's food. Head to the basement of Ceril's house, and use the bottle of poison on the range. Then, go upstairs and talk to Ceril Carnillean to learn that you've accidentally killed Scruffy the family dog instead; his son gave the meal to him. Talk to Clivet again, and he will have heard about the accident, but takes it as proof of your loyalty regardless. He'll give you [[Hazeel's mark]], then tell you to meet with their leader [[Alomone]] in their hideout. To get to the hideout, you need to find five [[Sewer valve]]s and turn them the proper direction. {{Checklist| *'''Valve 1''' - This is right across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 2''' - This is right behind Carnilleans' house. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 3''' - This is north of the cave. Turn it '''left'''. *'''Valve 4''' - This is south of the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it '''right'''. *'''Valve 5''' - Go south-east of the fourth valve, past the monk. Turn it '''right'''. }} [[File:Hazeel Cult - Hazeel revived.gif|thumb|200px|Hazeel emerges from his coffin.]] Go back to the cave and board the raft. Once you're in the main hideout, talk to [[Alomone]]. He wants you to help the Carnillean's butler, an undercover cultist, retrieve a [[Hazeel scroll| magical scroll of restoration]] that is hidden in the Carnilleans' house. Talk to [[Butler Jones]] in the house, who believes the scroll is hidden where even the family won't find it. Search the [[crate (Hazeel Cult)|crate]] in the basement for a [[Chest key (Hazeel Cult)|chest key]] (make sure to finish the dialogue to get the key in your inventory). Go up the ladder, then up the stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, on the northern side, then finally go up the ladder. Use the key on the chest to get the scroll. Return to Alomone to start Hazeel's resurrection.{{Clear}}
